svg.title: STM32F407 single-channel oscilloscope schematic
svg.desc: Buffered analog input, STM32F407 board ports, SPI TFT, four buttons, SWD, UART, DAC, and supply wiring. Port names are not physical header numbers.

g.text: VCC / backlight depend on the breakout.
PORT LABELS ARE MCU SIGNAL NAMES, NOT BOARD HEADER POSITIONS.
U1 IS A POWERED DEVELOPMENT BOARD WITH ITS OWN VDDA / VREF CIRCUIT.
INPUT RANGE: 0..3.3 V. CLAMPS DO NOT EXTEND THE VOLTAGE RATING.
PB12..PB15: INTERNAL PULLUPS. C3 CLOSE TO U2 SUPPLY PINS.
SINGLE CHANNEL / DC INPUT / SPI TFT
